variable_coverage.construction: Raw inputs: Compustat Industrial Annual raw income-statement, balance-sheet and cash-flow data for operating income, RNOA, net operating assets, ATO, PM, their changes, ΔNOA and interaction construction.; Annual Compustat Industrial population and historical SIC data for financial-industry exclusion, negative PM at t−1 exclusion, and the in-sample |ΔRNOA_{t+1}|>0.5 trim.. Construct ΔRNOA_{t+1} as RNOA_{t+1} − RNOA_t. Source definition: Change in return on net operating assets from t to t+1. RNOA is operating income divided by average net operating assets; operating income excludes interest, taxes, explicit special and nonrecurring items and is sales (net of discounts and allowances) less bad debt expense, cost of goods sold, SG&A, R&D, and depreciation and amortization. Average net operating assets is the average of current and prior net operating assets.. Exact current-vintage field-to-paper mapping limitations are recorded on the linked routes and in review notes.

Raw inputs: Compustat Industrial Annual raw income-statement, balance-sheet and cash-flow data for operating income, RNOA, net operating assets, ATO, PM, their changes, ΔNOA and interaction construction.; Annual Compustat Industrial population and historical SIC data for financial-industry exclusion, negative PM at t−1 exclusion, and the in-sample |ΔRNOA_{t+1}|>0.5 trim.. Construct RNOA_t as OPINC_t / ((NOA_t + NOA_{t−1})/2). Source definition: Current return on net operating assets: operating income after depreciation, before interest, taxes, and explicit special or nonrecurring items, divided by average net operating assets. Operating income is sales net of discounts and allowances less bad debt expense, cost of goods sold, selling, general and administrative expenses, research and development expense, and depreciation and amortization. Average net operating assets is the average of current and prior net operating assets; net operating assets equal net assets (equity) minus net financial assets; net financial assets equal cash plus short-term investments minus interest-bearing liabilities.. Exact current-vintage field-to-paper mapping limitations are recorded on the linked routes and in review notes.

Raw inputs: Compustat Industrial Annual raw income-statement, balance-sheet and cash-flow data for operating income, RNOA, net operating assets, ATO, PM, their changes, ΔNOA and interaction construction.; Annual Compustat Industrial population and historical SIC data for financial-industry exclusion, negative PM at t−1 exclusion, and the in-sample |ΔRNOA_{t+1}|>0.5 trim.. Construct ΔNOA_t as (NOA_t − NOA_{t−1}) / NOA_{t−1}. Source definition: Growth in net operating assets, computed as the change in net operating assets divided by prior-year net operating assets; NOA is net assets (equity) less net financial assets, and net financial assets equal cash plus short-term investments less interest-bearing liabilities.. Exact current-vintage field-to-paper mapping limitations are recorded on the linked routes and in review notes.

Construct ΔATO_t as (ATO_t − ATO_{t−1}) × PM_{t−1}. Source definition: Change in asset turnover attributable to turnover change: the raw change in ATO multiplied by prior-year profit margin. Asset turnover is revenues divided by average net operating assets; profit margin is operating income divided by revenues.. Construct ΔPM_t as (PM_t − PM_{t−1}) × ATO_{t−1}. Source definition: Change in profit margin attributable to margin change: the raw change in PM multiplied by prior-year asset turnover. Profit margin is operating income divided by revenues; asset turnover is revenues divided by average net operating assets..
